blocking.section: Runbooks > Holding deliveries during recovery (step 2, line 236); Runbooks > Region loss (non-home step 4, line 295)
blocking.issue: New regression from the L2-1 and L2-2 fixes. The hold tells operators to set `requireApproval: true` on every Environment. Region loss step 4 offers committing `requireApproval: true` as a way to hold promotions. The Configuration model allows `promotion.requireApproval` only with `promotion.from`, which is 'required when promotion is set'. A root Environment has no source to promote from, such as `staging` in RA-2 or the only Environment of a single-Environment deployment, so it cannot carry the field. Following step 2 literally puts an invalid `Environment` in `control/environments.yaml`. Ruralz Control then records a failed build for the recovery ref and ingests nothing, so the hold stalls. It is also an invented use of the field: requireApproval gates promotion records, and a root Environment never gets one. Its Rollouts start as soon as it ingests a commit. For such an Environment, the hold works only through where the recovery ref points, and the Region-loss hold only through a merge freeze.
blocking.evidence: line 236: "Push a recovery ref at that commit, plus a commit setting `requireApproval: true` on every Environment in `control/environments.yaml` (no digest changes)"; line 295: "approve nothing under `requireApproval`, else freeze merges to the tracked branch or first commit `requireApproval: true`, a tightening that needs no approval." 02-configuration-model.md line 542: "from: staging                  # required when promotion is set; the source commit must complete a Rollout there first"; 04-control-plane-and-gitops.md line 170: "Once a commit's Revision reached `complete` in every Cluster of `promotion.from`, the target Environment queues a promotion record"; foundation pack section 9: "`ruralz rollout approve` | Approve a promotion when `Environment.spec.promotion.requireApproval` is set".
blocking.fix: Hold step 2: write "setting `promotion.requireApproval: true` on every Environment that has `promotion.from` (no digest changes); an Environment without `promotion.from` cannot be gated, so it renders the recovery ref's head directly and is held only by where the ref points." Hold step 3: add "Place the ref at the root Environments' served commit first, since their empty plans complete at whatever the ref names." Region loss step 4: replace "or first commit `requireApproval: true`" with "or, for an Environment with `promotion.from`, first commit `promotion.requireApproval: true`, a tightening that needs no approval. An Environment without `promotion.from` is held only by a merge freeze."
